name: AI Hedge Fund — Deep Value
description: A port of ai-hedge-fund's deep-value pod: Graham, Buffett and Munger read the same point-in-time fundamentals independently, and one reconciliation weighs their convictions. Graham's view counts double, as the source's own strategy file specifies.

managers.name: AI Hedge Fund — Deep Value
managers.description: Three value analysts judge the same filed figures without seeing each other's answers, and their convictions are weighed into one judgement. Reasons from fundamentals and price alone — it is given no news and no thesis, because the harness it was ported from reads neither.

capabilities.reason: Filings and price history, asked of the vendors this machine holds credentials for. Each persona reads the vendor’s own response; nothing is mapped on the way.
The book as it stood, so a conviction about a business becomes a judgement about this portfolio rather than a rating in the abstract.
